title: Luxuriant Spicy Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A spicy and flavorful Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb kebabs, perfect for crowds, made with brown sugar and a blend of spices, and served on a lazy susan spinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat, then cover the bowl with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate the lamb for at least 2 hours or overnight to allow the flavors to meld.
Preheat a grill to medium high heat, threading the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers.
Grill the kebabs for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
While the kebabs are cooking, mix the brown sugar with 1 tablespoon of water to make a glaze.
Brush the glaze onto the kebabs during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Serve the kebabs hot on a lazy susan spinner, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as rice or roasted vegetables.
